text: huh. you made the whole walls disappear with the last edit i think. i dont see any of them now lol D: oh nevermind. i see them in the compiled game, not in the iso3d
resolution: Not a bug — no code change. User saw walls vanish in the iso3d build pane but present in the compiled game, and self-resolved ('oh nevermind'). Confirmed the cause in source: the iso pane has a 'W' hide-walls toggle (IsoAuthor wallsVisible, line 1377 — when off it filters every wall out of visiblePieces) plus a floor-level cut-away (geometry above the active F-level is hidden). Both are editor-view-only conveniences for seeing inside buildings and have zero effect on the compiled world, which is exactly the asymmetry observed. The concurrent z-fight dedup (req_0712/0713, sha f9d488a50) was ruled out as the cause: it runs identically in the compiled path where the walls render fine. Resolution: click 'W' to restore walls in the iso view.
